title: SpecialistOutput
description: What a single council reviewer returns. See spec/03-council.md §3.6. Every constraint below is a rejection condition: a response that violates any of them is a reviewer FAILURE, not an empty result.

reviewed.description: MUST be boolean true. Affirms engagement. Anything else — false, missing, the string "true" — is a failure. This is the anti-silence mechanism.

files_reviewed.description: Paths actually inspected. Empty is legal when the reviewer worked from the shared diff alone.

audit_rows_reviewed.description: Every in-scope deterministic audit row discharged, by label. [] only when no in-scope rows exist. Rows reported as findings still appear here.

summary.description: One-line conclusion in the reviewer's own words. REQUIRED even when candidates is empty — it is what lets a reader see what a quiet lane actually inspected.

candidate_ref.description: Response-local id (c1, c2, ...). The orchestrator namespaces it as <persona-id>:<ref>.

details.description: Concrete failure scenario: when X arrives, the code does Y, producing wrong state Z. Security findings state the attacker model.
